title: loved it!!
text:
An excellent option for city exploration!
My friends and I had an incredible experience together.
This is definitely something we’ll repeat on our next travels 😊
author: Rita_R

title: Granada has many layers...
text: Granada has many layers and this part of it is so important to understand the city. We have crossed some places that are truely lovely and unforgettable.
author: Patricia_F

title: Fun way to explore cheaply with a partner
text: Did this activity with my Girlfriend. Really glad we did. It showed us a load of the free areas that we didn't know were an option and we had a load of fun solving the problems, dashing about learning facts. Definitely gonna do more of these
author: Paul_J

title: New fun way to discover Alhambra
text: What a cool new way to discover the city ! It was super entertaining, and I have to say… we learned a lot about the city. Thank you Explorial.
author: Madeleine_M

title: Great fun and knowledgeable
text: We knew the game is about the open area of the Alhambra (it doesn’t include palaces and gardens). So, we planned to play it after our visit to the palaces. I couldn't be happier for all the fascinating things we learned about this unique place. Much more enjoyable than the boring audio guide we also get there. We enjoyed it very much!
author: Mary_A
